title: Santal gaon ka ghar
text: Mitti ki deewaron par laal, safed aur kaale rang ki pattiyan. Har Santal ghar apne aap mein ek kalakriti hai.

title: Dong aur Lagre naach
text: Haath mein haath daale ek line mein naachti mahilayein. Santal naach samuh aur ekta ka prateek hai.

title: Tamak' aur Tumdak'
text: Santal sangeet ki dhadkan: bada Tamak' (nagara) aur Tumdak' (madal) har parv mein goonjte hain.

title: Jaher than
text: Gaon ka pavitra sal-van, jahan Santal samaj apne devtaon ki puja karta hai.

title: Sohrai parv
text: Fasal katne ke baad ka utsav: gharon ki sajawat, pashuon ka samman, geet aur naach.

title: Baha parv
text: Basant mein sal ke phool khilne par manaya jaane wala phoolon ka parv.

title: Hul, 30 June 1855
text: Sidho-Kanhu ke netritva mein Santal Hul, shoshan ke khilaf aitihasik vidroh. Har saal 30 June ko Hul Diwas manaya jaata hai.

title: Karam parv
text: Karam daali ki puja aur raat bhar geet-naach. Prakriti aur parivar ka utsav.

title: Santali bhasha aur shiksha
text: 92ve Samvidhan Sanshodhan (2003) se Santali bhasha Samvidhan ki Aathvi Anusuchi mein shamil hui.

title: Santal Pargana
text: Hare dhaan ke khet, laal mitti ke raaste aur sal ke jungle. Hul ke baad bana Santal Pargana aaj Jharkhand ka pramandal hai.
